_help: One entry per game waiting for its video to go public. videoId null = not uploaded yet (fill it in when the upload is scheduled). The release job (channel/release_games.py, run every 15 minutes by .github/workflows/release-games.yml) checks YouTube; when the video is public it sets VIDEO_URL in the game file and adds the game to PUBLISHED in music/arcade-core.js, then marks the entry done.
